plan.notes: Source: 'Sample Degree Plan: Bachelor of Science (BS) Health Sciences', Bulletin Year 2022-2023 (shc.edu Program Checklists page). Sample plan; the Degree Audit in BadgerWeb is the official degree plan per the plan's own footer. Variable-credit rows resolved per the plan's own total (124): HSC 165 Emergency Medical Responder (0-1) recorded at 1 in semester 1 ('may take anytime in first 4 semesters'); the semester 3 PHL101/PHL190 row (0-3) recorded at 3 ('can take later but before Bioethics'); HSC 205 Health Science Shadowing (0-1) recorded at 0 (optional; 3.3 GPA and instructor permission required); the three 'Health Science Elective in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, or Nursing' rows (3-4) recorded at 3. Semester 2 prints 'PTh100I' (capital T). '300 or 400 Core Elective That Supports Major' rows are choice slots against the plan's list (select 2, 6 hours); 'Health Science Elective' rows are choice slots against the plan's list (select 3, minimum 9 hours). Sequenced sum 124 matches the printed 'Total Semester Hours: 124'.
